claim_verdicts.evidence: auto_sync (release-3.1): "By default, changes that are made to the live cluster will not trigger automated sync." Captured outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/gitops-self-heal.txt line 3: "30 s later: 4 replicas, OutOfSync" (script lines 20-23 at stage-3: scale, app_refresh, sleep 30).

auto_sync (release-3.1) YAML examples: "spec: syncPolicy: automated: prune: true" and "spec: syncPolicy: automated: selfHeal: true". tools/extract-code --tag stage-3: apps/staging.yaml lines 24-25 selfHeal: true / prune: true; deploy/gitops/lessons/staging-auto.yaml selfHeal: false / prune: false.

auto_sync (release-3.1): with selfHeal true "the sync will be attempted again after self-heal timeout (5 seconds by default)"; live-cluster changes trigger automated sync only with selfHeal. Script stage-3 lines 53-57: scale to 4, wait up to 120 s for 2, no commit, no app_refresh. Captured output line 15: "shortly after: 2 replicas, Synced".

Architecture (release-3.1): the application controller "continuously monitors running applications and compares the current, live state against the desired target state" and "detects OutOfSync application state". auto_sync: timeout.reconciliation "defaults to 120s with added jitter of 60s for a maximum period of 3 minutes", which supports "rereads Git every few minutes".

Sync Options (release-3.1), Selective Sync: "Currently, when syncing using auto sync Argo CD applies every object in the application." Neither apps/staging.yaml nor staging-auto.yaml at stage-3 sets syncOptions. Captured output line 6: "after the sync of that commit: 2 replicas"; envs/staging/api.yaml at stage-3 line 20 "replicas: 2".

auto_sync (release-3.1): "automated sync will not delete resources when Argo CD detects the resource is no longer defined in Git." Sync Options: "The app will be out of sync if Argo CD expects a resource to be pruned." Captured output lines 7-8: "configmap/prune-demo", "ConfigMap/prune-demo: requiresPruning=true" after app_wait OutOfSync at the removal commit (line 40).
auto_sync (release-3.1), verbatim: "By default, changes that are made to the live cluster will not trigger automated sync." OutOfSync side: captured output line 3 "30 s later: 4 replicas, OutOfSync".

Round 2. auto_sync (release-3.1): "Automated sync will only attempt one synchronization per unique combination of commit SHA1 and application parameters"; "a second sync will not be attempted, unless `selfHeal` flag is set to true." Automatic Pruning: by default automated sync will not delete resources; prune enables it. Output lines 12-13: "staging: Synced, Healthy", NotFound prune-demo; no commit between script lines 40 and 52.

Resource Tracking (release-3.1): "Argo CD uses the argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id annotation to track application resources"; a resource whose tracking annotation does not reference it "will neither affect the application's sync status nor be marked for pruning."

issues.text: Round 2, new (changed text). Line 50 now says selfHeal lifts the one-sync-per-commit limit, which I can follow. But Core concepts defines self-heal only as syncing when the live objects change, so this second effect surprises me. And 'whether or not it was synced before' leaves me unsure whether the removal commit was synced: s5 only says a second commit removes the manifest and line 40 waits for OutOfSync.
issues.quote: `selfHeal` lifts that limit, so a sync can start at the removal commit whether or not it was synced before.
issues.fix: Add one clause to the self-heal entry in Core concepts: 'and it lets Argo CD sync a commit it has already tried', so line 50 points back to a defined effect.
